generated_from: the newest official source read in this round (never a wall clock)

hca.rule: HCA is pinned to the measured home-win rate, never fitted: HCA = sigma x probit(home_win_rate), where sigma is the standard deviation of the game margin (home - away) over the official log.

E1.name: results log
E1.fitting: least-squares ratings on game margin with HCA pinned; a symmetric team 'environment' term for the total

oos.walk_forward: fit on all earlier games, score game 61 onward
oos.shrink_note: the shrink constant is fixed before scoring; the grid is published so the choice can be inspected. Selecting the constant by looking at these four rows would be selection, so the figure above should be read as slightly optimistic.

E2.name: efficiency page
E2.inputs: official team advanced page (OffRtg, DefRtg, Pace) + official standings
E2.fitting: total = possessions x points-per-possession; ppp = OffRtg/100 x DefRtg_opp/100 / (league ppp), possessions = mean pace of the two clubs

oos.note: only games settled after the page was read can score E2 out of sample; one so far, which is far too few to weight it

blend.rule: w_i = exp(-logloss_i) normalised; an estimator receives weight only once it has at least 30 out-of-sample games. Until then the measured estimator carries the blend and the weights are published with the sample sizes.
blend.note: E2's weight is 0 because the official efficiency page is a single current snapshot: it has produced one out-of-sample game so far. The blend therefore equals E1 today and the published headline is the disagreement, not the blend.

headline: disagreement
headline_rule: the headline number on every projection row is |E1 - E2| (points and win probability). The blend is printed underneath it and is never the headline.

luck.rule: z = (actual wins - expected wins) / sqrt(sum p(1-p)) over the walk-forward out-of-sample games, where p is E1's pre-game probability for that club. |z| > 1.96 means the club's record is outside the noise band: a strategy may not lean on it.
